name: fp8_e4m3_quad
description: Default with fp8 E4M3 operands sent as 4-bit indices into 8-bit LUTs (the quad arm). The LUTs are made as the compiler always has: one per 2 rows of A / columns of B / rows of C (G = 1), B and A fitted by k-means to their own codes, a chained stage's C fitted to an fp32 estimate of its output, indices picked by value on the host.
